meta.title: J Pictures — AI Webtoon Studio
meta.description: J Pictures is a webtoon studio that plans, produces and distributes original webtoon IP with an AI image-generation pipeline.

about.label: About
about.statement:
*AI* draws it fast.
*People* see the story through.
about.lead: Founded in 2026, J Pictures is an AI webtoon studio. We plan and produce original IP through an AI image-generation pipeline and launch it on platforms in Korea and abroad.

values.title: Story first
values.desc: Technology is only a tool; the story is what keeps readers. We design each season's narrative before anything else.

values.title: AI production pipeline
values.desc: AI image generation and our own workflow cut the time from concept to finished episode.

values.title: Consistent quality
values.desc: Character sheets and style guides keep the same faces and tone in every episode, and every final panel is retouched by hand.

business.label: Business
business.title: From concept to distribution
business.lead: From the moment an IP is born to the moment it meets readers, J Pictures handles every step itself.

items.title: Original IP development
items.desc: We develop original webtoon IP in-house, from world and characters to season structure.

items.title: AI webtoon production
items.desc: An AI image-generation workflow lets us produce series episodes quickly and reliably.

items.title: Visual development
items.desc: We build character sheets, background concepts and a style guide for every title.

items.title: Distribution & global
items.desc: We launch on Korean platforms and handle localization and distribution overseas.

pipeline.label: AI Pipeline
pipeline.title:
Drawn with AI,
finished with taste
pipeline.lead: We never publish generated panels as they are. We refine direction and detail by hand to keep each title's tone.

steps.title: Storyboard & prompts
steps.desc: Panels and direction turned into generation specs

steps.title: Retouching
steps.desc: Expressions, hands and details fixed by hand

steps.title: Editing & lettering
steps.desc: Speech bubbles, SFX and vertical-scroll pacing

steps.title: Review & launch
steps.desc: Quality and rating review, then platform launch

about.label: About
about.statement:
絵は*AIが速く*、
物語と演出は*人が最後まで*。
about.lead: J Picturesは2026年に設立されたAIウェブトゥーン制作会社です。AI画像生成をベースにした制作工程でオリジナルIPを企画・制作し、国内外のプラットフォームで展開します。

values.desc: 技術は道具にすぎません。読者をつかむのは物語です。まずシーズン単位で物語を設計します。

business.label: Business
business.title: 企画から流通まで
business.lead: ひとつのIPが生まれて読者に届くまで、すべての工程をJ Picturesが自ら手がけます。
